Subject: Re: Proposed Sudan Training Participants
Dear Khaled,
Two hours should be sufficient! November works for us, but we would prefer NOT the week of November 6 or
November due to VIP visits in Sudan. For a meeting platform, do you have a preference when it comes to Google
Meets or Microsoft Teams? We could do either.
Did you also receive my message about the Libya trainees? We would like to do the Sudan and Libya teams separately
if possible. If it would be easier to discuss with a quick call let me know some times that would work for you and 1 can
call in the next couple of days!
Best,
Sara
